issues.problem: Not an accusative dual: a dual would end in -ī/-ā (or -āntau), never -aḥ. mahaḥ can only be gen./abl. sg. of mah, nom./acc. sg. of mahas 'greatness', or acc. pl.; so the translation 'you two, the great ones' has no grammatical support (the gloss 'the great two' too).
issues.fix: Relabel gram as 'form uncertain (not dual)' and rework 'vām maho dadhe' (e.g. maho as 'greatness' or a gen., object of dadhe unclear); needs a human decision.

issues.problem: Ungrammatical Hindi: 'मुझ की'; the participial phrases belong to the genitive 'of me'.
issues.fix: मुझ ऋत के अनुसार चलने वाले और जीतने की इच्छा करने वाले की इस वाणी

patch.old: ऋत के अनुसार चलने वाले और जीतने की इच्छा करने वाले मुझ की इस वाणी
patch.new: मुझ ऋत के अनुसार चलने वाले और जीतने की इच्छा करने वाले की इस वाणी

issues.problem: dadhe is 'I place/hold'; 'hold to' adds a preposition not in the line and does not match the Hindi 'धारण करता हूँ' or the gloss.
issues.fix: I hold you two, the great ones (once the form of maho is settled)

patch.old: hold to you two, the great ones
patch.new: hold you two, the great ones

issues.problem: 'acting by the order' is not the sense of ṛtāyant (following / devoted to the order); it also differs from the English 'who follow the order'.
'te', 'idam' and 'pura' are not rendered in either translation although the notes list them as the unclear part; nothing should be dropped silently.
issues.fix: Render them literally (e.g. 'those two ... this ... before') or state in notes that they are left untranslated.

issues.problem: guhyāḥ agrees with ripaḥ, which is masculine; 'f./m.' is wrong.

issues.where: इन दुष्ट अनिष्ट करने वालों के हाथ
issues.problem: 'के हाथ' (into the hands of) is added; duścunābhyaḥ is a plain dative/ablative 'to'.
issues.fix: इन दुष्ट अनिष्ट करने वालों को न सौंपो

patch.old: इन दुष्ट अनिष्ट करने वालों के हाथ न सौंपो
patch.new: इन दुष्ट अनिष्ट करने वालों को न सौंपो

issues.problem: āyoḥ is dropped in the Hindi although the English has 'day of life'.
'wish' (and Hindi 'विषय') is an unsupported addition: the line has viddhi tasya naḥ only (a genitive 'of that', 'of us'); nothing about a wish is in the text.
issues.fix: Drop the invented noun, e.g. keep the genitives literal ('take note of that, of us') and explain in notes. Hindi 'हमारे उस विषय को जानो' needs the same repair.

issues.problem: sumnāyant is 'seeking favour' (sumna = favour in the fixed renderings); 'kindly' blurs it.

issues.where: तत्काल तत्परता से सुनने को ले आओ, जो ... गाय के समान है
issues.problem: Two additions: 'तत्काल' (immediately) is not in the text, and 'के समान' turns the cow apposition into a simile, although the English (and the notes) take it as apposition (duhānāṃ dhenuṃ pipyuṣīm asaścatam are accusatives of śruṣṭim).
issues.fix: तत्पर श्रवण को ले आओ, दुही जाती हुई, भरी हुई, कभी न घटने वाली गाय को।

patch.old: तत्काल तत्परता से सुनने को ले आओ, जो दुही जाती हुई, भरी हुई, कभी न घटने वाली गाय के समान है।
patch.new: तत्पर श्रवण को ले आओ, दुही जाती हुई, भरी हुई, कभी न घटने वाली गाय को।

issues.problem: puru-hūta (puru + ppp. hūta) is not a bahuvrīhi; it is a compound of adverbial first member with a participle ('much-invoked').
'उन्हीं' (only those) adds emphasis not in tābhiḥ.

summary: Reviewed 8 units of RV 2.32. Total issues: 3 error, 12 minor. Errors: unit 1 gram of mahaḥ as acc. du. is impossible (and so the translation 'you two, the great ones'); unit 2 'wish'/'विषय' invented in 'viddhi tasya naḥ'; unit 3 Hindi adds 'तत्काल' and a simile 'के समान'. Minor: unit 1 ungrammatical Hindi 'मुझ की', 'hold to', ṛtāyataḥ gloss, dropped te/idam/pura; unit 2 guhyāḥ gender, 'के हाथ', dropped āyoḥ in Hindi, sumnāyant not rendered as 'seeking favour'; unit 3 puruhūta not a bahuvrīhi; unit 5 'उन्हीं'. Units 4, 6, 7, 8 are ok. No text flags needed. Confidences (low/medium) are honest. No regrouping suggested.
